sections.heading: Treatment for Polk County, from our Johnston campus
body: We are a Polk County facility treating Polk County residents. Our Johnston campus is central to the county, which means we work with the same hospitals, courts, employers and referral networks our clients already deal with — and that familiarity removes friction at exactly the moment someone is deciding whether to start treatment.

Because Polk County covers both dense urban neighbourhoods and quieter suburbs, the pressures people arrive with vary widely. Our assessment looks at your environment as much as your substance use, because the plan that works has to survive the place you go home to.

sections.heading: Getting here from Polk County
body: We are at 5820 Winwood Dr, Johnston, IA 50131 — centrally located from Polk County, with easy access from I-35, I-80 and I-235. Familiar landmarks nearby include Des Moines, Johnston, Ankeny, Urbandale, Altoona and Pleasant Hill.

sections.heading: Start treatment near Polk County today
body: Admissions specialists are available 24/7. Calls are free, confidential, and carry no obligation to enrol.
